g.text: Claude in ANZ, end to end
From the training cluster to a prompt typed in Sydney. Dashed = not published by AWS or Anthropic.
Amazon Bedrock · ANZ Regions (Sydney · Melbourne · Auckland)
one per model provider, per Region
owned by Bedrock · Anthropic has no access
prefill, then decode token by token
1 train · 2 ship the checkpoint to each Region · 3 load onto the fleet · 4 your app calls Sydney · 5 tokens stream back · 6 logs and billing stay in your account.
